product_metadata.title: iDesign Una Rectangular Trash Handles, Waste Basket Garbage Can for Bathroom, Bedroom, Home Office, Dorm, College, 12" Inch
features: VERSATILE: Ideal for your bathroom, kitchen, office, bedroom, dorm, craft room, kitchen, living room, or any other space. Compact size makes it easy to fit next to the countertop or toilet
BUILT-IN HANDLES: Integrated side handles make it easy to transport the trash can between rooms or empty into a larger waste can
DURABLE: Plastic construction makes the waste can durable for years of use
STYLISH: Classic black color matches a variety of bathroom decors
IDEAL SIZE: Each slim trash can measures 12" x 6.5" x 10.8" with an 8 quart capacity to fit in small spaces throughout your home
description: The iDesign Una Trash Can is a modern and functional addition to your space. It features a sleek, streamlined design perfect for your kitchen, dorm, bedroom, bathroom, office, or anywhere else in your home. Integrated handles make it easy to move the garbage can from room to room or take out the trash. Made of durable plastic, this wastebasket is designed to last for years to come. It provides ample room for garbage or recycling. Measuring 12" x 6.5" x 10.8", the Una Waste Can is slim and will fit perfectly wherever you need it. With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #LiveSimply every day.
The InterDesign Una 12" Can is a versatile addition to any home or office. It features a sleek, streamlined design with an integrated handle and is available in a variety of colors.
